create_health_servicer: create a HealthServicer instance to manage gRPC service health status for multiple services
check_service_health: check the health status of a named gRPC service using the HealthServicer Check method
watch_service_health: watch a gRPC service for health status changes using the HealthServicer Watch streaming RPC
set_service_status: set the health status of a named service using the HealthServicer set method
enter_graceful_shutdown: enter graceful shutdown by setting all services to NOT_SERVING via enter_graceful_shutdown
